title: Difficult to Clean, Easy to Carry, Use a Different Brush
text: Difficult to Clean, Easy to Carry, Use a Different Brush. It's really about where your priorities are set that will determine if these Goodful Stainless Steel Collapsible Telescoping Silicone Tip Portable and Reusable Straw Set will work for you or not. The good points are they are portable, re-usable and have a silicone tip to be more gentle on your teeth and easier for little ones to use. Even when used as the instructions state, using the included brush is much too short. I had to remember to buy some new brushes while I was out. If the straw becomes dented in the least way, it will no longer work. These really aren't too great, because they are a bit more fragile than regular metal straws, they will just not poke through some materials as easily due to folding down smaller and they can fit in a pocket. These may work well for some users, and be non-impressive or frustrating for others. Either way, you will need to buy your own brush as the included one may just be nice to have in the pouch to get the worst of the mess  while out until you are back home.

product_metadata.title: Goodful Stainless Steel Collapsible Telescoping Straws With Silicone Tips, Portable and Reusable Straw Set with Carry Bag and Cleaning Brush, 2 Pack, Teal and Blue
features: SET INCLUDES: 2 collapsible stainless steel straws with silicone tips, cleaning brush and drawstring carry bag.

CONVENIENCE ON-THE-GO: Easily bring a straw with you everywhere you go with these collapsible stainless steel straws. These sturdy straws come with a cleaning brush for easy cleaning on the go, as well as a carrying case for clean storage.
PREMIUM STAINLESS STEEL: These stainless steel straws are constructed with premium 304-grade stainless steel, which is known for its durability, appearance and resistance to corrosion.

EASY TO CLEAN: These straws are easy to clean, too- just place them on the top rack of your dishwasher. The silicone tips are removable for easy cleaning, and the included cleaning brush will make sure you clean in tough-to-reach areas.

COMFORTABLE SIPPING: Sip from the soft silicone straw tip and keep your teeth and lips from touching the metal. The silicone tip is removable for easy cleaning. Use these stainless steel straws in any size tumbler- they fit all standard tumbler straw openings.

SAVES THE ENVIRONMENT: Instead of using single-use disposable straws, you can be environmentally friendly with reusable straws. Perfect for sipping your favorite soft drinks, water and more, these straws are a great way to enjoy your beverages without negatively impacting the Earth.
description: Enjoy beverages on the go without the guilt of using disposable straws with every sip you take. With these Goodful stainless steel collapsible straws, you can easily tote these high-quality straws with you wherever you go. The straws collapse to easily store inside the included drawstring carry bag, so this straw set can easily fit in any purse, backpack or pocket for on-the-go convenience. The straws telescope to be the perfect height for any glass, bottle or cup- tall or short, so you will always have the right size straw with you. The soft silicone tops are comfortable to sip from, keeping your teeth and lips from touching the stainless steel. The best part? These straws are easy to clean! Place the in the top rack of the dishwasher or use the included cleaning brush while out and about to clean these straws fast and easy.
